value.rationale: This canonical recent finite-ring counterexample is fully understood at the null-polynomial module level rather than via an isolated witness. Exact kernel generators, the polynomial-function module and its 2^30 count, the index-two constant right-stabilizer, and optimality of degree six clarify the structural mechanism of the first known failure of a long-standing conjecture. The motivated cutoff and complete natural invariant are substantial despite the finite scope.
